full_name: Stefan Helmreich | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Stefan Helmreich is the Elting E. Morison Professor of Anthropology at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. His research has centered on how biologists think through the limits of “life” as a category of analysis.
